title: Wearing an Accent
text:
Title: Wearing an Accent

Like many people crossing borders to live in other worlds, I now have an accent in each 
language I speak. Everyone has an accent, of course. And dominant accents are hardly the exemplars 
that they are made out to be. All vernaculars are in flux, for one. But I am referring to my blending of several 
accents at once in English, Arabic, or French, with 
nearly no “native” accent in any language. My accents wax and wane, depending on my entourage and where I am living.

clues.clue: I am a verb that turns into a noun when you add an -ing, and I often require looking both ways before you proceed.
Often associated with streets or international boundaries when traveling.
Moving from one side to the other.
I separate one nation from another, yet I can also be a crispy edge of a grilled cheese sandwich.
You might find these on maps, at airports, or around a plate of food.
Lines that mark the limits of a territory or area.
I am pluralities of Earth, but also vast distances between two people who simply do not understand each other.
Each person lives in their own personal sphere, shaped by culture and experience.
Planets that may support life, or distinct realms of existence.
I have no physical form, yet I can unite millions of strangers or drive a travel agency crazy.
It consists of vocabulary, grammar, and syntax, allowing humans to express complex ideas.
A system of communication used by a particular community or nation.
I am the pinnacle of a category, often displayed in museums or textbooks for others to study.
Teachers and leaders are often held up as these for students and followers to imitate.
Perfect models of a particular quality or type.
I am the everyday tongue of the streets, contrasting sharply with the formal dialects used in courtrooms.
These forms of speech often evolve naturally within communities rather than being formally taught in schools.
Dialects spoken by the ordinary people of a specific region.
I am the river that never stands still, a constant shifting that prevents anything from settling down.
Economies, weather patterns, and public opinion are frequently described as being in this state.
A continuous and often unpredictable state of change.
I am the gentle marriage of separate elements, much like how different melodies harmonize in a choir.
Chefs do this with ingredients, while artists do it with colors on a canvas.
The process of mixing two or more things together to form a unified whole.
I am the original inhabitant, the one who has called a forest or city home since the very beginning.
Plants, animals, and residents who were born in a specific location can all be described this way.
Originating or occurring naturally in a particular place.
I am the swarm of advisors, assistants, and friends that orbits a famous figure like planets around a sun.
Celebrities, politicians, and royalty typically travel with this kind of supportive staff and companions.
A group of people attending or surrounding an important person.
